transformations.stock_tr: Before the splice, nominalize Shiller's real total-return index with CPI and use December-to-December ratios; thereafter use Damodaran annual total returns.
transformations.bond10_tr: Before the splice, chain all twelve Shiller monthly gross bond factors; thereafter use Damodaran annual total returns.
transformations.tbill_tr: Unavailable before the splice; thereafter use Damodaran annual bill returns.
transformations.tbill_dtb3_tr: Unavailable before 1928; Damodaran annual bill returns through 1953; annual arithmetic mean of numeric daily FRED DTB3 percentages divided by 100 from 1954, reconciled with Damodaran through 1981.
transformations.cpi_change: Before the splice, use Shiller December-to-December CPI ratios; thereafter use Damodaran annual CPI changes.
transformations.rounding: Eight decimal places; reconstructed quality before the splice and ok thereafter.
